description: Shared vectors for how often a track's fixes are labelled, marked with a symbol or given a direction arrow (CAP-32). An interval is a whole number of seconds from 1 s to 24 h. read: text an analyst or an agent types, and the seconds it means, "off", or the problem said; debrief_kernel.time.read_interval and readInterval in vscode/webview/frequencies.ts must agree. describe: seconds and the words for them, as step names and the form say them (describe_interval, describeInterval). track: a track's intervals as its details show them (debrief_stac.frequencies.describe_track, describeFrequencies).
